tasks.gr8-cash-payments-business-ownership-t3: Topic: Cash payments, business ownership and management. Cover cash payments journal and ledger control, sole trader and partnership business structures with advantages and disadvantages, management levels and decision-making, budgeting, and market concepts of supply and demand. Ask Grade 8 learners to record cash payments, compare ownership structures, explain liability differences, and analyze real business scenarios involving budgets and market decisions.
tasks.gr8-cash-payments-journal-t3: Topic: The Cash Payments Journal (CPJ) of a service business and the combined cash journals. Cover the purpose (money paid out), the columns (date, document number, details, Bank and analysis columns such as Rent, Telephone, Salaries and Equipment), source documents (cheque counterfoils, till slips), entering payments, closing off by cross-casting, combining the CRJ and CPJ (the cash balance carried forward equals receipts minus payments and agrees with the bank statement), and the effect on the accounting equation (an expense lowers assets and owner's equity; buying equipment swaps one asset for another). Use the same business: receipts R17 000, payments R5 100, balance R11 900. Ask Grade 8 learners to total, cross-cast and find the balance.
tasks.gr8-forms-of-ownership-t3: Topic: Forms of ownership at characteristics level. Cover the sole trader, partnership (sharing profit in a ratio), close corporation (limited liability; no new close corporations can be registered since 1 May 2011 and existing ones continue), private company ((Pty) Ltd) and public company (Ltd, shares sold to the public), limited liability, advantages and disadvantages, and the role of businesses in sustainable job creation and the sustainable use of natural resources. Do not give legal detail such as section numbers. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify forms, share a profit and weigh advantages and disadvantages.
